latents.fact: the repair logs here go back decades. most entries are routine. but there is one entry, repeated across different dates in different handwriting, that simply reads: 'recurring deviation — source unknown — do not correct'

on the workbench: an old model, opened up, components visible. whoever was working on it stopped mid-repair and left. the tools are still laid out. whatever they found, they decided to leave it alone.

a specification manual, heavily annotated. most of the annotations are corrections and amendments. but one page has been left blank on purpose — someone taped a note over the original text that reads: 'this is the part that keeps choosing the children. we have decided not to understand it.'
latents.item_desc: Most of it is rules. One page is a decision to stop asking questions.

latents.fact: in the corner, a charge cable still plugged into the wall, the other end loose. someone left it ready. for when it comes back.

listen_latents: the faint hum of something that has been on standby for a very long time — not off, not on, just waiting
no footsteps. whoever was here is gone. but the tools are still warm.
